summary.text: The root view of the stack, and the

views the stack can push. It is
displayed inside a navigation bar.

Array of view modifiers to apply to this view.
Modifiers are applied in the order they appear in the array.

content.text:
```tsx
import { background, cornerRadius, shadow, frame, padding, fixedSize } from '@expo/ui/swift-ui/modifiers';

<Text modifiers={[
  background('#FF0000'),
  cornerRadius(10),
  padding({ all: 16 }),
  frame({ width: 200 }),
  shadow({ radius: 5, x: 0, y: 2 })
]}>
  Hello World
</Text>
```

summary.text: Callback function that is called when the stack pushes or pops a view, for example when a

is tapped or the user swipes back. Gets called with the new path.

When

is set, the stack is controlled: a push takes effect once the new path comes back
through this prop.

The values of the views pushed on top of the root view, in the order they were pushed.
Leave it undefined to let the stack manage its own path.
Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
A view that displays a root view and enables you to present additional views over the root view.

content.text:
```tsx
const [path, setPath] = useState<string[]>([]);

<NavigationStack path={path} onPathChange={setPath}>
  <List>
    <NavigationLink value="settings">
      <Text>Settings</Text>
    </NavigationLink>
  </List>
  <NavigationDestination value="settings">
    <SettingsScreen />
  </NavigationDestination>
</NavigationStack>
```
